svg.title: SURGE: A fast open-source chemical graph generator: every isomer of a formula. An isomer counter on a bench plate: three number wheels behind a bezel engraved C4H10O count the skeleton, the site of the oxygen and the bond orders, a crank on the side turns once per isomer, and a paper tape fed from a roll on the lid prints each of the seven constitutional isomers of C4H10O as a SMILES line.
